name: 1f3f0df5-enum-standard-editor
description: Регресс ошибки 1f3f0df5 (ревизия 2026-10-19): перечисления редактора отбора («Тип действия», «Вид сущности») строит стандартный редактор значения — рамка .st-f-chipfield, чипы-облачка с подписями, поле .value-chips-input с живым поиском, каретка «▾», полный список открывается кареткой; чеклист-кнопки «Выбрать значения…» и .ui-chip-list нет. На узкой колонке значения чипы переносятся, поле ввода доступно. Запуск: node client/scripts/ui-probe-stand.mjs --scenario client/scripts/ui-probe.1f3f0df5-enum-width.scenario.json

probe.name: actionField
probe.expression: (() => { const row=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .ft-row'); const field=row.querySelector('.fv-enum .st-f-chipfield'); const input=row.querySelector('.fv-enum .value-chips-input'); const caret=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum button')].find((b)=>(b.textContent??'').trim()==='▾'); return { field: field!==null, input: input!==null, placeholder: input===null?null:input.placeholder, caret: caret!==undefined, chipList: row.querySelector('.ui-chip-list')!==null, checklistBtn: [...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum button')].some((b)=>(b.textContent??'').includes('Выбрать значения')) }; })()

steps.name: open-action-list
steps.eval: (() => { const row=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .ft-row'); const caret=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum button')].find((b)=>(b.textContent??'').trim()==='▾'); if(!caret) return 'no-caret'; caret.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: pick-created
steps.eval: (() => { const items=[...document.querySelectorAll('.type-combo-list .type-combo-item')]; const row=items.find((i)=>(i.textContent??'').includes('создал(а)')); if(!row) return 'no-row'; row.click(); return 'ok'; })()

probe.name: actionChip
probe.expression: (() => { const row=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .ft-row'); const cell=row.querySelector('.ft-row__value'); const field=row.querySelector('.fv-enum .st-f-chipfield'); const input=row.querySelector('.fv-enum .value-chips-input'); const chips=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .st-f-chipfield .prop-ref-cloud')]; const labels=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .st-f-chipfield .prc-title')]; const w=(e)=>Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().width*100)/100; return { cell: w(cell), field: w(field), input: w(input), chips: chips.map(w), labels: labels.map(w), texts: labels.map((l)=>l.textContent) }; })()

steps.name: action-chip-nonzero
steps.probe: (() => { const row=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .ft-row'); const field=row.querySelector('.fv-enum .st-f-chipfield'); const input=row.querySelector('.fv-enum .value-chips-input'); const chips=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .st-f-chipfield .prop-ref-cloud')]; const labels=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .st-f-chipfield .prc-title')]; return field.getBoundingClientRect().width>0 && input.getBoundingClientRect().width>0 && chips.length===1 && chips.every((c)=>c.getBoundingClientRect().width>0) && labels.length===1 && labels[0].getBoundingClientRect().width>0 && (labels[0].textContent??'').trim()==='создал(а)'; })()

steps.name: pick-updated
steps.eval: (() => { const items=[...document.querySelectorAll('.type-combo-list .type-combo-item')]; const row=items.find((i)=>(i.textContent??'').includes('изменил(а)')); if(!row) return 'no-row'; row.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: narrow-value-cell
steps.eval: (() => { const cell=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .ft-row .ft-row__value'); cell.style.flex='0 0 120px'; cell.style.width='120px'; const field=cell.querySelector('.fv-enum .st-f-chipfield'); const input=cell.querySelector('.fv-enum .value-chips-input'); return JSON.stringify({field:Math.round(field.getBoundingClientRect().width),input:Math.round(input.getBoundingClientRect().width)}); })()

steps.name: narrow-panel-wraps
steps.probe: (() => { const row=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .ft-row'); const field=row.querySelector('.fv-enum .st-f-chipfield'); const input=row.querySelector('.fv-enum .value-chips-input'); const chips=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .st-f-chipfield .prop-ref-cloud')]; const fw=field.getBoundingClientRect().width; const fh=field.getBoundingClientRect().height; return fw>0 && fw<=130 && input.getBoundingClientRect().width>0 && chips.length===2 && chips.every((c)=>c.getBoundingClientRect().width>0 && c.getBoundingClientRect().width<=fw+0.5) && fh>40; })()

probe.name: entityField
probe.expression: (() => { const row=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .ft-row[data-path="1"]'); const field=row.querySelector('.fv-enum .st-f-chipfield'); const input=row.querySelector('.fv-enum .value-chips-input'); const caret=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum button')].find((b)=>(b.textContent??'').trim()==='▾'); return { field: field!==null, input: input!==null, placeholder: input===null?null:input.placeholder, caret: caret!==undefined, chipList: row.querySelector('.ui-chip-list')!==null, checklistBtn: [...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum button')].some((b)=>(b.textContent??'').includes('Выбрать значения')) }; })()

steps.name: open-entity-list
steps.eval: (() => { const row=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .ft-row[data-path="1"]'); const caret=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum button')].find((b)=>(b.textContent??'').trim()==='▾'); if(!caret) return 'no-caret'; caret.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: pick-thought-entity
steps.eval: (() => { const items=[...document.querySelectorAll('.type-combo-list .type-combo-item')]; const row=items.find((i)=>(i.textContent??'').trim()==='мысль'); if(!row) return 'no-row'; row.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: entity-chip-nonzero
steps.probe: (() => { const row=document.querySelector('.activity-filter .ft-row[data-path="1"]'); const field=row.querySelector('.fv-enum .st-f-chipfield'); const input=row.querySelector('.fv-enum .value-chips-input'); const chips=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .st-f-chipfield .prop-ref-cloud')]; const labels=[...row.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .st-f-chipfield .prc-title')]; return field.getBoundingClientRect().width>0 && input.getBoundingClientRect().width>0 && chips.length===1 && chips[0].getBoundingClientRect().width>0 && labels.length===1 && labels[0].getBoundingClientRect().width>0 && (labels[0].textContent??'').trim()==='мысль'; })()

steps.name: no-legacy-chip-list-anywhere
steps.probe: (() => { const panel=document.querySelector('.activity-filter'); return { chipLists: panel.querySelectorAll('.ui-chip-list').length, checklistButtons: [...panel.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum button')].filter((b)=>(b.textContent??'').includes('Выбрать значения')).length, standardFields: panel.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .st-f-chipfield').length, inputs: panel.querySelectorAll('.fv-enum .value-chips-input').length }; })()
